correctness.rationale: Take unordered pairs of distinct cyclic states and height h their minimal cyclic separation, with antipodal orientation fixed at n even. Compute two potential coordinates (A,B), piecewise A=h(n-1)-i/B=h or A=(m-1)n-i/B=m. All transitions satisfy A−A(after a)≤1 and B(after a)=B, while A(after b)≥A and B−B(after b)≤1; direct inspection of both wrap cases and the n=2,3 boundaries shows R=A+B has exactly one outgoing rank-decreasing letter at every pair. The displayed word a^(n−1−i)b(a^(n−1)b)^(h−1), or antipodal adjustment, reaches singleton using precisely A a-letters and B b-letters. Thus all positive weighted costs are lower-bounded componentwise and uniquely attained; R-values partition 1,…,C(n,2) into consecutive height blocks. Independent pair-transition and 3-cost reverse-Dijkstra verification checked all pairs for n=2…18; universal proof is the one-step transition analysis, not finite Dijkstra.
